question: Does one of the L115's barrel packages carry a velocity factor that explains EA's 664 m/s against the stored 742 (the open item of L3360)?

sourceFacts.method: The four muzzle velocity effect files (WME_MuzzleVelocity_*) were read for their factor (Field_6a5c4efd). Every weapon-modifier, ability, attachment and unlock file under Weapons was byte-searched for the four effect file GUIDs to find which packages use them. The barrel unlocks imported by L115A3_Ability were listed (wpmvel.py) and joined to packages by name.

control.description: The byte search finds each effect in named packages (Short barrels and subsonic ammunition for the reductions, Extended barrels for the increase), so the search does see package-to-effect links.

sourceFacts.earlierReceipt: frosty-1.4.2.5-l115-velocity.json: Basic Barrel branch has no velocity modifier; site value changed from 664 to 742

inference: The L115's four barrels give 742 (Basic, Fluted), 593.6 (Short, x0.8) and 927.5 (Extended, x1.25). None gives 664; the factor needed is 0.8949 and no stored effect holds it.
The reading offered in L3360 (EA's figure includes a default-barrel penalty of 0.8^0.5) is not supported by stored data and is withdrawn.

EA's old and new L115 figures keep the ratio of the other .338 and 7.62 bolt rifles (703 to 664 is -5.55%, as 720 to 680). Stored 742 is 1.1175 times EA's 664 and the same ratio applied to 703 gives 785.6; so the stored value is consistently about 11.8% above EA's figure for this one rifle.
Either EA's table is wrong for the L115 or the L115's velocity is changed somewhere not read (a level or mode override, or the ammunition package). The site keeps the stored 742.
unresolved: In-game check: L115 with Basic Barrel, time of flight to a target at a known distance (664 or 742 m/s; at 300 m the difference is about 0.05 s before drag), or the velocity shown on the weapon's stat card.
The L115's ammunition packages were not checked for a velocity effect beyond the GUID search, which found none outside subsonic ammunition.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: No stored barrel package turns the L115's 742 m/s into EA's 664: the only velocity factors are 0.8, 0.64, 0.512 and 1.25
leads.summary: The L115's stored muzzle velocity is 742 m/s and its four barrel packages give 742, 742, 593.6 and 927.5; the only stored velocity factors are 0.8, 0.64, 0.512 and 1.25. Nothing stored produces EA's 664, so the default-barrel explanation suggested in L3360 is withdrawn and the difference stays open for an in-game reading. 7 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: An in-game L115 velocity reading or a corrected EA figure.
leads.statusNote: Hypothesis from L3360 rejected by stored data; difference unexplained.
